pokedexEntries.bk: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

pokedexEntries.wh: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. Their favorite food is life energy.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Its body is mostly seawater. It’s said there’s a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

pokedexEntries.as: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

pokedexEntries.us: Jellicent is always hanging around fancy cruise ships and tankers, hoping to drag away its prey.

pokedexEntries.um: Fishermen are terrified of Jellicent. It’s rumored to drag them into the sea and steal their lives away.

pokedexEntries.sw: Most of this Pokémon's body composition is identical to sea water. It makes sunken ships its lair.

pokedexEntries.sh: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.
